name: Visa de Migrante (M) -- Trabajador

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a labor agreement or service contract with a natural or legal person domiciled in Colombia. Visa validity matches the contract's duration, up to 3 years. Applicants must apply from abroad at a Colombian consulate -- a tourist visa/visa-free entry cannot be converted to work authorization from inside Colombia.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying contract and apply from a Colombian consulate abroad.

evidence_required.document: Labor or service contract with a Colombian-domiciled employer/client
Professional license/qualification, if the occupation is regulated
Foreign ID card (Cédula de Extranjería), required if employment exceeds 3 months

outcome.duration_length: matches the underlying contract, up to 3 years

sources.title: Ministerio del Trabajo de Colombia -- Trabajadores extranjeros en Colombia: contract-based work visa (TP-4), employer reporting obligations

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Colombia's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 via the Ministry of Labour. Employers must notify Migración Colombia in writing within 15 calendar days of hiring/termination, and generally must cover return-home costs for internationally recruited workers. pr_after_months (60) reflects the general 5-year track for 'worker' under co_resident_by_accumulated_time (tier-3 sourced there; flagged accordingly in that file, not restated as certain here).
